title: Python Data Engineering & Automation
tagline: Build the pipelines and automation that power real systems with Python: scripting and CLI tools, web scraping and data acquisition, data engineering (ETL, validation, warehousing), big data and orche…
summary: Build the pipelines and automation that power real systems with Python: scripting and CLI tools, web scraping and data acquisition, data engineering (ETL, validation, warehousing), big data and orchestration (PySpark, Airflow, dbt, streaming), and the cloud, containerization, and reliability practices that ship pipelines to production. Prepares for Data Engineer, Automation, and platform-adjacent roles.

capstone.title: End-to-end orchestrated data pipeline
capstone.project: Build a scheduled, tested ETL pipeline that ingests from a source (API/scrape/file), validates and transforms the data, loads it into a warehouse with incremental/idempotent loads and data-quality gates, and is containerized with logging and alerting.

phases.title: Automation & Scripting
phases.goal: Automate real tasks with robust Python scripts and polished CLI tools.

projects.title: Command-Line Tools with argparse
projects.description: Build a real CLI tool with argparse: positional and optional arguments, subcommands, help text, and proper exit codes — the stdlib way to make scripts usable.

projects.title: Modern CLIs with Typer
projects.description: Build polished CLIs with Typer (built on Click): type-hint-driven commands, options with help, prompts, and colored output — far less boilerplate than argparse.

projects.title: Filesystem Automation
projects.description: Automate bulk file operations with pathlib and shutil: organize, rename, deduplicate, and process files safely — with dry-run support and idempotency.

projects.title: Scheduling Automation
projects.description: Run tasks on a schedule: cron for system-level scheduling and APScheduler for in-process jobs — and learn idempotency, overlap, and failure handling for scheduled work.

projects.title: API Data Collection
projects.description: Collect data from REST APIs robustly: pagination, rate limiting, retries with backoff, authentication, and saving results — the foundation of API-based data ingestion.

projects.title: Spreadsheet Automation
projects.description: Automate spreadsheet and CSV work: read, transform, and generate spreadsheets with pandas and openpyxl — formatted reports, multiple sheets, and formulas — replacing manual spreadsheet drudgery.

projects.title: Notifications & Alerts
projects.description: Send automated notifications — email (SMTP) and chat (incoming webhooks) — so your scripts and pipelines tell you about successes, failures, and results.

projects.title: Robust Automation Scripts
projects.description: Make automation production-grade: structured logging, retries with backoff, clear exit codes, configuration, and idempotency — turning a fragile script into a reliable, observable job.

phases.title: Web Scraping & Data Acquisition
phases.goal: Acquire data from the web responsibly — static and dynamic sites, APIs, and documents.

projects.title: Web Scraping with BeautifulSoup
projects.description: Fetch and parse static HTML to extract structured data: navigate the DOM with BeautifulSoup, select with CSS selectors, and turn a web page into clean rows.

projects.title: Forms, Sessions & Pagination
projects.description: Scrape sites that need state: keep cookies across requests with a session, log in by posting a form, and follow pagination to collect every page of results.

projects.title: Ethical Scraping: robots.txt, Rate Limiting & Politeness
projects.description: Scrape responsibly: read and respect robots.txt, identify yourself, rate-limit and back off, cache to avoid re-fetching, and understand the legal/ethical lines so your scraper is a good citizen.

projects.title: Large-Scale Crawling with Scrapy
projects.description: Graduate from scripts to a framework: build a Scrapy spider that crawls, follows links, yields structured items, and exports data — with built-in concurrency, throttling, and pipelines.

projects.title: Scraping Dynamic Sites with Playwright
projects.description: Scrape JavaScript-rendered pages a plain HTTP fetch can't see: drive a real browser with Playwright, wait for content to load, interact (click/scroll/fill), and extract from the live DOM.

projects.title: Parsing HTML, XML & Structured Documents
projects.description: Go beyond CSS selectors: parse XML/HTML with lxml and XPath, consume RSS/Atom feeds and sitemaps, and handle namespaces and malformed markup robustly.

projects.title: Extracting Data from PDFs & Documents
projects.description: Liberate data trapped in documents: extract text and tables from PDFs with pdfplumber, read .docx/.xlsx files, and handle scanned pages with OCR — turning unstructured documents into structured data.

projects.title: Storing Scraped Data: Pipelines, Dedup & Incremental Saves
projects.description: Close the loop on acquisition: store scraped records durably (CSV/JSONL/SQLite), deduplicate with stable keys, and scrape incrementally so re-runs only fetch what's new — a complete, resumable acquisition pipeline.

phases.title: Data Engineering Core
phases.goal: Build reliable ETL: clean, validate, model, and load data into warehouses.

projects.title: Efficient pandas at Scale
projects.description: Make pandas fast and memory-efficient on large data: pick the right dtypes, vectorize instead of looping, process in chunks, and measure memory — so your transforms scale beyond toy datasets.

projects.title: Data Cleaning & Transformation
projects.description: Turn messy real-world data into a clean dataset: handle missing values, fix types and inconsistent categories, remove duplicates, parse dates, and reshape — the unglamorous work that makes data usable.

projects.title: Data Validation with Pandera
projects.description: Stop bad data at the gate: declare schemas with Pandera that enforce types, ranges, nullability, uniqueness, and custom rules — failing loudly when input violates expectations instead of silently corrupting downstream data.

projects.title: Designing ETL Pipelines
projects.description: Structure data pipelines properly: separate Extract, Transform, and Load into composable stages, understand ETL vs ELT, and build a pipeline that's modular, testable, idempotent, and observable.

projects.title: SQL Databases with SQLAlchemy
projects.description: Move data in and out of relational databases efficiently: connect with SQLAlchemy Core, run parameterized queries safely, bulk-load with pandas, and use transactions — the load layer of real pipelines.

projects.title: Data Warehousing & Dimensional Modeling
projects.description: Model data for analytics: understand warehouses vs OLTP databases, design star schemas with fact and dimension tables, handle slowly changing dimensions, and build a dimensional model from raw data.

projects.title: Columnar Storage with Parquet
projects.description: Store analytical data efficiently: use Parquet's columnar format for fast, compressed, typed reads, partition datasets for query pruning, and understand why columnar beats CSV/row formats for analytics.

projects.title: Incremental & Idempotent Loads
projects.description: Load only what changed, safely: track high-water marks, detect changes, implement upserts/merge, design idempotent loads that survive retries and backfills without duplicating data — the heart of production pipelines.

projects.title: Data Quality Checks & Monitoring
projects.description: Keep data trustworthy over time: define quality dimensions and checks (completeness, freshness, uniqueness, distribution), run them as automated gates, monitor for anomalies, and alert when data quality degrades.

phases.title: Big Data & Orchestration
phases.goal: Scale and schedule pipelines with PySpark, Airflow, dbt, and streaming.

projects.title: PySpark Fundamentals
projects.description: Process data that doesn't fit on one machine: understand distributed computing, create a SparkSession, load and explore data as a Spark DataFrame, and grasp how Spark partitions and parallelizes work across a cluster.

projects.title: Spark Transformations & Actions
projects.description: Understand Spark's execution model: lazy transformations build a plan, actions trigger it, and wide transformations cause shuffles. Read the DAG, know what's expensive, and reason about how Spark runs your code.

projects.title: Spark SQL, Joins & Aggregations
projects.description: Transform big data with Spark SQL: write SQL against DataFrames, join large datasets, aggregate and window at scale, and understand join strategies (shuffle vs broadcast) that determine performance.

projects.title: Spark Performance Tuning
projects.description: Make Spark jobs fast: minimize shuffles, cache reused data, control partitioning, fix data skew, and read the Spark UI to find bottlenecks — the optimization skills that turn hours into minutes.

projects.title: Workflow Orchestration with Airflow
projects.description: Schedule and orchestrate pipelines: model a workflow as an Airflow DAG of tasks with dependencies, schedule it, and understand operators, the scheduler, and how Airflow runs and tracks data pipelines.

projects.title: Production Airflow: Retries, Sensors, Backfills & Idempotency
projects.description: Make orchestrated pipelines production-grade: idempotent tasks parameterized by execution date, retries and alerting, sensors that wait for data, and safe backfills of historical windows.

projects.title: Analytics Engineering with dbt
projects.description: Transform data in the warehouse the modern way: build dbt models as SQL SELECTs, layer staging→marts, add tests and documentation, and use refs/lineage — the ELT 'T' that analytics teams run on.

projects.title: Streaming Data with Kafka
projects.description: Process data as it arrives, not in nightly batches: understand event streaming, produce and consume messages with Kafka, grasp topics/partitions/offsets/consumer groups, and reason about batch vs streaming.

projects.title: Stream Processing with Spark Structured Streaming
projects.description: Compute on streams with the same DataFrame API as batch: read a stream, apply transformations and windowed aggregations, handle event-time and late data with watermarks, and write results with checkpointing for fault tolerance.

phases.title: Cloud, Testing & Reliability
phases.goal: Ship pipelines: cloud SDKs, containers, CI/CD, testing, logging, and observability.

projects.title: Cloud Storage with boto3 (the cloud provider SDK)
projects.description: Work with cloud infrastructure from Python: use boto3 to read/write object storage (the data lake), handle credentials securely, stream large objects, and understand object storage as the foundation of cloud data platforms.

projects.title: Containerizing Data Jobs with Docker
projects.description: Package a pipeline so it runs identically everywhere: write a Dockerfile, build a lean image, pass config via environment, handle dependencies, and run your job as a reproducible container.

projects.title: Testing Data Pipelines with pytest
projects.description: Test pipelines like software: unit-test pure transforms, use fixtures and sample data, test edge cases, mock external systems, and add data-quality assertions — so changes don't silently break your data.

projects.title: CI/CD for Data Pipelines with GitHub Actions
projects.description: Automate quality and deployment: build a GitHub Actions workflow that lints, tests, and builds your pipeline on every push, then deploys (e.g. pushes an image) — so changes are validated and shipped automatically.

projects.title: Configuration & Secrets Management
projects.description: Manage config and secrets the right way: separate config from code (12-factor), layer env/files/defaults, validate config with Pydantic Settings, and pull secrets from a secrets manager instead of env or code.

projects.title: Logging, Monitoring & Observability
projects.description: See what your pipelines are doing: emit structured logs, expose metrics, trace runs, and build the observability that lets you answer 'is it healthy?' and debug failures fast — the difference between flying blind and operating with confidence.

projects.title: Reliability Patterns for Pipelines
projects.description: Design pipelines that survive failure: retries with backoff, idempotency, dead-letter queues for poison records, circuit breakers and timeouts for flaky dependencies, and graceful degradation — so partial failures don't become outages or corrupt data.

projects.title: Serverless & Event-Driven Data Processing
projects.description: Process data without managing servers: write a function (a serverless function runtime) triggered by events (a file landing in object storage, a queue message), understand the serverless model and its tradeoffs, and design event-driven pipelines.

projects.title: Capstone — Production Data Pipeline
projects.description: Build a complete, production-grade data pipeline end to end: ingest from a source, validate and transform, load to a warehouse with incremental/idempotent loads and quality gates, orchestrated/scheduled, tested, containerized, with logging and alerting — integrating every skill in the track.
